generations.name: G20 (inkl. LCI 2022)
generations.notes: The dimensions are from BMW press data sheets for the pre-facelift car (320i 07/2019, 320d 02/2020). A sedan has no published VDA maximum with the seats folded (40:20:40 split rear seat). The M3 Limousine (G80) is not covered.

data.notes: I kept this short on purpose (80/20), using 11 searches. Official BMW and ADAC data cover the key values: trunk volumes per drivetrain for 3er Limousine and Touring, 5er Touring G61 and i5 Touring, and X5 LCI. The main findings: the PHEV trunk is smaller in the 3er and the X5. The 5er Touring G61 has the same 570-1700 l for every drivetrain, including the PHEV and the i5. The M5 Touring has 500-1630 l. I did not add the 5er Limousine G60 / i5 Limousine, which is in the same segment, because another list may already cover it. Check that and add it if it is missing.
